column1: # Java libraries replaced inside Apache Cassandra's lib/ (DESIGN.md D-55).
# Cassandra vendors its dependencies, and 5.0 ships guava, snappy-java,
# jackson, netty and lz4-java below their security fixes, with no newer
# Cassandra release to repin to. Each row swaps one of those JARs for a fixed
# release from Maven Central at build time.
#   series      Cassandra series the row applies to (5.0); must match a
#   replaces    the JAR in /opt/cassandra/lib it removes, or - for a JAR that
#               is only added (a dependency the new version needs)
#   sha256      of that JAR, checked against Central's published checksums
#               when the row was written, and by sha256sum at every build
# replace-jars.sh fails the build if a row's "replaces" JAR is missing, so a
# base repin that already moved a library stops here rather than leaving two
# versions on the classpath. Check 45 validates this file.
# 4.1 has no rows: it is no longer maintained here (DESIGN.md D-57). Its
# snakeyaml could not move past 1.33, because 4.1's YamlConfigurationLoader
# calls constructors snakeyaml 2.0 removed, so CVE-2022-1471 stayed open.
